answer: Proof of Stake protocols resist Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital, creating a lotus of influence where voting power scales linearly with tokens. If an attacker attempts to dilute the network with fake identities, they must reach the financial nadir of exhausting their own resources to acquire supply. This economic constraint ensures that each digital echo of the network remains tethered to actual value, rendering the cost of global identity forgery prohibitively expensive for adversaries.
